explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Italeni" (revision 1370266163) says: "However, it has been speculated that, without the lessons learnt as a result of the Battle of Italeni - such as fighting from the shelter of ox-wagons whenever possible and choosing the place of battle rather than being enticed into unfavourable terrain - the Voortrekkers would not have succeeded in finally beating the Zulus at the Battle of Blood River eight months later." The edge reads that sentence as: Battle of Italeni made Battle of Blood River possible, and nothing more.
